summary: Candidate is a distinct read-only inspection micro-skill for querying D3 transition metadata and state (d3.active(), transition.selection/nodes/node/size/empty). It does not overlap with existing skills: 'Disable Controls During Content Transition' (interaction safety, state management) and 'Future State Transition Control' (concurrent task mutation). Peer candidates address custom tweens, array sorting, and extremum lookup—all orthogonal domains. The candidate has clear semantic identity, supported evidence, and no conflicts.
